28489-the-belove-d-vagabond.title: The Belove D Vagabond
28489-the-belove-d-vagabond.creator: William J. Locke
28489-the-belove-d-vagabond.description: A book by William J. Locke. I did not resent these charges, direct and implied, against my mother. She did launder villainously, and she did drink gin, and of the nine uncared-for gutter-snipes she brought into the world, I think I was the most unkempt and neglected.

arxiv-1705-09414.title: Lepton masses and mixing in a scotogenic model
arxiv-1705-09414.creator: E. C. F. S. Fortes, A. C. B. Machado, J. Montaño, V. Pleitez
arxiv-1705-09414.description: Abstract We consider an extension of the standard model with three Higgs doublet model and S 3 × ℤ 2 S_{3}\times\mathbb{Z}_{2} discrete symmetries. Two of the scalar doublets are inert due to the ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetry. We have calculated all the mass spectra in the scalar and lepton sectors and accommodated the leptonic mixing matrix as well.

arxiv-2105-13616.title: Positional information as a universal predictor of freezing
arxiv-2105-13616.creator: Tamoghna Das, Tsvi Tlusty
arxiv-2105-13616.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tamoghna Das, Tsvi Tlusty. Variation of positional information, measured by the two-body excess entropy 𝖲 2 \mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{2}} , is studied across the liquid-solid equilibrium transition in a simple two-dimensional system. Analysis reveals a master relation between 𝖲 2 \mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{2}} and the freezing temperature T f T_{\mathrm{f}} , from which a scaling law is extracted: − 𝖲 2 ∼ | T f − T | − 1 / 3 -\mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{2}}\sim|T_{\mathrm{f}}-T|^{-1/3} . Theoretical and practical implications of the observed universality are discussed.

arxiv-2107-07369.title: From data to noise to data: mixing physics across temperatures with generative artificial intelligence
arxiv-2107-07369.creator: Yihang Wang, Lukas Herron, Pratyush Tiwary
arxiv-2107-07369.description: Abstract Using simulations or experiments performed at some set of temperatures to learn about the physics or chemistry at some other arbitrary temperature is a problem of immense practical and theoretical relevance. Here we develop a framework based on statistical mechanics and generative Artificial Intelligence that allows solving this problem.

arxiv-2302-12773.title: Towards multi-task learning of speech and speaker recognition
arxiv-2302-12773.creator: Nik Vaessen 1 , David A. van Leeuwen 1
arxiv-2302-12773.description: Abstract We study multi-task learning for two orthogonal speech technology tasks: speech and speaker recognition. We use wav2vec2 as a base architecture with two task-specific output heads. We experiment with different architectural decisions to mix speaker and speech information in the output sequence as well as different optimization strategies.

arxiv-2405-13749.title: History of N ⁡ ( 1680 ) N(1680)
arxiv-2405-13749.creator: Igor Strakovsky
arxiv-2405-13749.description: Abstract This paper describes my personal appreciation for some of the great research achievements of Mitya Diakonov, Vitya Petrov, and Maxim Polyakov and how my own research career has followed the paths they opened. Among the topics where they have been the most influential have been the pursuit and study of the exotic pentaquark.

arxiv-2406-18224.description: Abstract We provide the first fully polynomial-time randomized approximation scheme for the following two counting problems: 1. Given a Context-Free Grammar G G over alphabet Σ \Sigma , count the number of words of length exactly n n generated by G G 2.

arxiv-2406-19568.title: How Far are AI-generated Videos from Simulating the 3D Visual World: A Learned 3D Evaluation Approach
arxiv-2406-19568.creator: Chirui Chang, Jiahui Liu, Zhengzhe Liu, Xiaoyang Lyu, Yi-Hua Huang, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Di Zhang, Xiaojuan Qi
arxiv-2406-19568.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chirui Chang, Jiahui Liu, Zhengzhe Liu, Xiaoyang Lyu, Yi-Hua Huang, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Di Zhang, Xiaojuan Qi. Recent advancements in video diffusion models enable the generation of photorealistic videos with impressive 3D consistency and temporal coherence. However, the extent to which these AI-generated videos simulate the 3D visual world remains underexplored.

arxiv-2503-03808.title: Evolution of a kink-antikink ensemble in a quantum vacuum
arxiv-2503-03808.creator: Mainak Mukhopadhyay ID, Kohta Murase ID, Atsushi Naruko ID, George Zahariade ID
arxiv-2503-03808.description: Abstract We study the 1 + 1 1+1 flat spacetime dynamics of a classical field configuration corresponding to an ensemble of sine-Gordon kinks and antikinks, semi-classically coupled to a quantum field. This coupling breaks the integrability of the sine-Gordon model resulting in the background’s decay into quantum radiation as kink-antikink pairs annihilate.

arxiv-2503-15120.title: Communication Access Real-Time Translation Through Collaborative Correction of Automatic Speech Recognition Conference: Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26-May 1, 2025; Yokohama, Japan Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in C
arxiv-2503-15120.creator: Korbinian Kuhn, Verena Kersken, Gottfried Zimmermann
arxiv-2503-15120.description: Abstract . Communication access real-time translation (CART) is an essential accessibility service for d/Deaf and hard of hearing (DHH) individuals, but the cost and scarcity of trained personnel limit its availability. While Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) offers a cheap and scalable alternative, transcription errors can lead to serious accessibility issues.

arxiv-2505-18204.title: Brownian Bridge Augmented Surrogate Simulation and Injection Planning for Geological CO 2 Storage
arxiv-2505-18204.creator: Haoyue Bai, Guodong Chen, Wangyang Ying, Xinyuan Wang, Nanxu Gong, Sixun Dong, Giulia Pedrielli, Haoyu Wang, Haifeng Chen, Yanjie Fu
arxiv-2505-18204.description: Abstract Geological CO 2 storage (GCS) involves injecting captured CO 2 into deep subsurface formations to support climate goals. The effective management of GCS relies on adaptive injection planning to dynamically control injection rates and well pressures to balance both storage safety and efficiency.

arxiv-2506-09014.title: Learning to Reason Across Parallel Samples for LLM Reasoning
arxiv-2506-09014.creator: Jianing Qi, Xi Ye, Hao Tang, Zhigang Zhu, Eunsol Choi, [2pt] CUNY Grad Center, Princeton University, BMCC, CCNY, New York University[2pt] jqi@gradcenter.cuny.edu, xi.ye@princeton.edu, htang@bmcc.cuny.eduzzhu@ccny.cuny.edu, eunsol@nyu.edu
arxiv-2506-09014.description: Abstract Scaling test-time compute brings substantial performance gains for large language models (LLMs). By sampling multiple answers and heuristically aggregate their answers (e.g., either through majority voting or using verifiers to rank the answers), one can achieve consistent performance gains in math domains. In this paper, we propose a new way to leverage such multiple sample set.

arxiv-2506-20499.title: Adaptive Supergeo Design: A Scalable Framework for Geographic Marketing Experiments
arxiv-2506-20499.creator: Charles Shaw. This version: August 8, 2026
arxiv-2506-20499.description: Abstract Geographic experiments are a gold-standard for measuring incremental return on ad spend ( iROAS ) at scale, yet their design is challenging. The unit count is small, heterogeneity is large, and the optimal Supergeo partitioning problem is NP-hard. We introduce Adaptive Supergeo Design (ASD), a two-stage framework that renders Supergeo designs practical for thousands of markets.

arxiv-2511-01106.title: Defining a Role-Centered Terminology for Physical Representations and Controls CCS: Human-centered computing HCI theory, concepts and models Conference: arXiv.org, Cornell University; 2025; Ithaca, NY, USA
arxiv-2511-01106.creator: Guillaume Rivière
arxiv-2511-01106.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Guillaume Rivière. Previous classifications advanced research through a better understanding of the field and the variety of tangible user interfaces and related physical user interfaces, especially by discretizing a degree of tangibility based on the specimens produced by the community over the years, since the conceptualization of Tangible User Interface initiated a research effort to deepen the exploration of the concept. However, no taxonomy enables the classification of tangible user interfaces at the application level.

arxiv-2601-10522.title: Nested hyperedges promote the onset of collective transitions but suppress explosive behavior
arxiv-2601-10522.creator: Federico Malizia, Andrés Guzmán, Federico Battiston, István Z. Kiss
arxiv-2601-10522.description: Abstract Higher-order interactions can dramatically reshape collective dynamics, yet how their microscopic organization controls macroscopic critical behavior remains unclear. Here we develop a new theory to study contagion dynamics on hypergraphs and show that nested hyperedges not only facilitate the onset of spreading, but also suppress backward bifurcations, thereby inhibiting explosive behavior.

pmc-11521888.creator: Salma Sameh, Ahmed M. Elissawy, Eman Al-Sayed, Rola M. Labib, Hsueh-Wei Chang, Szu-Yin Yu, Fang-Rong Chang, Shyh-Chyun Yang, Abdel Nasser B. Singab
pmc-11521888.description: IntroductionCancer is the second most widespread cause of mortality following cardiovascular disorders, and it imposes a heavy global burden. Nowadays, herbal nutraceutical products with a plethora of bioactive metabolites represent a foundation stone for the development of promising chemopreventive and anticancer agents. Certain members of the family Malvaceae have traditionally been employed to relieve tumors.

pmc-12449666.title: Identifying Firearm Violence Exposure in Primary Care Clinical Notes: Protocol for Developing a National Language Processing Text Classifier
pmc-12449666.creator: Natalie Carwright, Frances M Biel, Megan Hoopes, Ali Al Bataineh, Pedro Rivera, Kerry Bet, Nicole Cook, Amy Schwartz, Tope Amusa, Sonish Sivarajkumar
pmc-12449666.description: BackgroundStructured data codes capture acute bodily injury from firearm violence but do not necessarily describe follow-up care from bodily injury and secondary exposure to firearm violence (eg, witnessing a shooting, being threatened by a firearm, or losing a loved one to gun violence and injury from firearms) even though such exposure is associated with many short- and long-term health impacts.

pmc-13477943.title: Surgical excision of an infraorbital nerve schwannoma via a transconjunctival approach with lateral canthotomy: a case report
pmc-13477943.creator: Jonathan Andrés Panchi-Lasluisa, Virgen María Acuña-Peña, Sebastián Álvarez-Razo, Juan Marcos Parise-Vasco
pmc-13477943.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Schwannoma is a benign, encapsulated, slow-growing tumor that arises from Schwann cells. Approximately 25%–45% of extracranial schwannomas occur in the head and neck region, accounting for 1%–8% of all neoplasms. However, involvement of the infraorbital nerve is exceptionally rare. This report describes the surgical management of an infraorbital nerve schwannoma using a transconjunctival approach with lateral canthotomy, and documents the clinical, functional and aesthetic outcomes at 12 months.

pmc-13696571.title: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and premature mortality: A narrative review of the literature
pmc-13696571.creator: Yasmin Rahali, Charlotte A. Dennison, Anita Thapar, Ajay K. Thapar
pmc-13696571.description: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is associated with a higher risk of premature mortality compared to the general population, although reported risks vary. The aim of this paper was to review studies that have examined associations between premature mortality and ADHD and consider factors that could explain variation in risk estimates.

uslaw-usc-t10-s8326.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8326 — Enlisted members: 30 years
uslaw-usc-t10-s8326.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8326.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 841 (Voluntary Retirement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Each enlisted member of the Regular Navy or the Regular Marine Corps who applies for retirement after completing 30 or more years of active service in the armed forces shall be retired by the President. (b) For the purpose of subsection (a).
